args.reason: Every DoD item serves the first PRD goal (inspect merge eligibility without risking a merge): the dry run reports merge-ok or the specific blocked conditions and never calls gh pr merge, asserted by a test double. It reuses the existing floor reads rather than adding a second eligibility path, so the second goal (floor logic stays the single source of truth) holds. Nothing in the DoD goes beyond the declared goals, and no historical storage or query feature is added.
